match_nodes.description: Nebraska LB 525 — Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act

data.official_name: Nebraska Legislative Bill 525 — Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act
data.description: Nebraska statute requiring providers of human-like conversational AI and companion chatbot services to conspicuously disclose that the user is interacting with an AI rather than a human, maintain mental health crisis detection and referral protocols, and refrain from representing the chatbot as a licensed mental or behavioral health professional.
data.notes: Status: Enacted in 2026; operative July 1, 2027 (109th Nebraska Legislature; verified as of 2026-11-03).
